PARP‐1‐deficient mice have a significantly attenuated allergic response, and the underlying mechanism involves a calpain‐dependent proteolytic degradation of STAT‐ 6.
PARP‐1‐deficient mice have reduced airway inflammation and hyperresponsiveness in a murine model of asthma, and this is due to the inhibition of STAT‐6‐dependent IL‐5 production.

the data in this study show that PARP‐1 plays a role in the development of allergic airway inflammation and that this role may be related to its ability to regulate IL‐5 expression.
